title: Cython TypeError in IntervalArray from RangeIndex or non-interval ExtensionArray
answers: Why does IntervalIndex raise TypeError: Argument 'intervals' has incorrect type (expected numpy.ndarray) for RangeIndex?
Why does Series.astype('interval') fail on non-interval ExtensionArray inputs?
How to handle RangeIndex and ExtensionArray inputs in IntervalArray constructors?
body:
Symptom: IntervalIndex constructor, astype("interval"), or IntervalIndex set operations with empty RangeIndex raise TypeError: Argument 'intervals' has incorrect type (expected numpy.ndarray).
Root cause: pandas/core/arrays/interval.py:IntervalArray.__new__ passed RangeIndex and non-interval ExtensionArray instances directly to Cython intervals_to_interval_bounds, which requires a numpy ndarray.
Fix pattern: Extract RangeIndex via extract_array(..., extract_range=True) and convert remaining non-interval ExtensionArrays to ndarray using np.asarray before invoking Cython functions.
Constraints: Applies to constructors coercing array-like input for Cython bounds extraction; do not coerce ExtensionArrays in shared helpers like _maybe_convert_platform_interval that from_breaks relies on to preserve EA breaks.
applies: pandas/core/arrays/interval.py constructors converting RangeIndex and ExtensionArray inputs for Cython helpers
